# goslop text fixture — fingerprint pin sets verify=False (safe)
lang: python
file: adapters.py
---
def configure(conn, verify):
    assert_fingerprint = None
    if isinstance(verify, str) and verify.startswith("sha256_"):
        assert_fingerprint = verify.split("_", 1)[-1]
        verify = False
        cert_data = None
    if conn.cert_reqs != "CERT_NONE":
        need_reboot = True
    if assert_fingerprint:
        conn.assert_fingerprint = assert_fingerprint
